description: Ministry of Public Administration Management and Law & Order - 4th Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of the Service Minute for the Sri Lanka Administrative Service and outlines the syllabus for recruitment examinations to Grade III of the service. This falls under public sector recruitment and service conditions, specifically addressing administrative procedures for public service examinations, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
